newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker fuel dormant ahead of Easter weekend.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker fuel dormant ahead of Easter weekend.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were little changed in extremely quiet trade on Thursday with most needs ahead of the Easter holiday already met, dealers said.
"Supply is good; demand is non-existent," one trader said. "Most majors have already shut their doors for Easter. It's absolutely dead in the water."

Rotterdam 380 cst bunker fuel was unchanged at $89 a tonne, with 180 cst at $95. Antwerp 380 cst was $1 below Rotterdam while 180 cst was likewise at $95. Hamburg prices were slightly firmer, with one dealer noting tightness in barges up to April 1-2. Hamburg 380 and 180 cst were about $2 up at $93/94 and $99/100 respectively.
Algeciras was mixed with mild congestion ahead of Easter and calmer weather after storms. Dealers put 380 cst at $99, down $3, and 180 cst at $104/105, up about $5.
Fos and Augusta were unchanged and very quiet and Piraeus was also steady at about $92 for 380 cst and $97 for 180 cst.
Durban was also little changed with 180 cst at $93.
